🚨 9-1-1 — Drama / Emergency
9-1-1 follows police officers, firefighters, dispatchers, and other first responders as they handle emergencies while dealing with challenges in their personal lives.
Every call brings a different situation, forcing the responders to make quick decisions while helping people during some of their most difficult moments. The series also focuses on the relationships, struggles, and lives of the people behind the uniforms.
The series explores courage, teamwork, family, friendship, sacrifice, and resilience.
